project_type: Python FastAPI application - Autonomous AI Company Operating System (NEXUS)
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (auto mode), tests/ at project root, conftest.py with mock fixtures
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany && python -c "import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(f.read_text()) for f in pathlib.Path('src').rglob('*.py')]"
verification_instructions: 1. AST parse all new Python files to verify syntax. 2. Run pytest on new test files. 3. Verify imports resolve correctly.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network, use pre-installed Python 3.11+
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no pip install, no Docker, no external HTTP. Use only pre-installed runtimes. Validate with AST parsing and pytest on pure logic tests.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT modify existing Phase 1-4 files unless strictly necessary. Register new routes only in main.py. Export new models in models/__init__.py.
key_patterns: Models: SQLModel with table=True, uuid.UUID id + company_id fields, Field(default_factory=uuid.uuid4). API routes: APIRouter with tags, Pydantic BaseModel for request/response, DbSession and CurrentCompanyId deps. Governance modules: dataclass-based state, in-memory storage, async methods. Tests: class-based grouping, pytest fixtures from conftest.py, test pure logic without DB.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ - main package. src/nexus/api/routes/ - FastAPI route modules. src/nexus/governance/ - governance layer (in-memory). src/nexus/models/ - SQLModel table definitions. tests/ - pytest test files.
